next_step: Finalize POC perf run: 48h embedding refresh on dedicated pool, then security questionnaire sign-off
notes:
Summary:
- Company: DevCache EmbedWorks — developer tooling startup (IDE copilot + code search).
- Primary interest: high-throughput embedding refresh pipelines + low-latency streaming for in-IDE copilot.

Technical requirements / context:
- Background workload: nightly+incremental embedding refresh across ~200 customer repos (mono-repo and poly-repo mix). Estimated corpus ~1.2B tokens, growing.
- Throughput target: sustained 30k-60k embeddings/min during batch windows; burst capacity for initial full refresh (target 200k embeddings/min for short bursts).
- Latency target for copilot streaming: token latency <100ms for local dev IDE sessions (prefers continuous streaming + partial completion).
- Model/versioning: require model pinning per release, reproducible rollbacks, and A/B routing for staged rollouts. Want recommended quantized variants for cost/latency tradeoffs.
- Indexing: delta-first pipeline (Airflow orchestrated) with repo-level sharding, dedupe step, and incremental KV/prefix caching to avoid recomputation.
- Batching/caching: want automatic batch size tuning, prefix/KV cache across similar files, and explicit control over max latency vs cost.

Security / compliance:
- Must support VPC/private control plane or on-prem distribution for Tier-1 customers.
- SSO (SAML) + SCIM, SOC2 baseline required. KMS integration for key management, audit logging and 7-year retention controls for customer A.
- Data residency requirement for some EU customers — need region pinning.

POC / timeline / recent activity:
- 2024-09-18: Intro call (AE Jordan Park). Captured requirements, agreed to POC scope.
- 2024-09-20: Security scoping session; sent initial questionnaire (ff_20240920_1122).
- 2024-10-03: Architecture deep-dive with SE (Ravi Menon). Discussed batching strategies and KV cache expectations (ff_20241003_3847).
- 2024-10-10: Delivered POC plan and cost model draft; awaiting security updates from customer.
- POC plan: 48h dedicated pool run simulating 2 weeks of incremental embeds + 24h low-latency streaming test in dev IDE; measure tokens/sec, p50/p95 token latency, cost per 1M tokens.

Quotes / customer voice:
- CTO: "We need predictable economics for nightly embedding refreshes and sub-100ms in-editor responses — can't have cost surprises during indexing windows."

Open action items:
- Redwood: provide detailed cost model for nightly refresh (full+incremental) including quantized model variants and dedicated pool pricing.
- DevCache: complete and return security questionnaire; provide list of EU customers for residency mapping.
- Joint: schedule 48h perf POC (provision dedicated pool + test data set).

Decision drivers / blockers:
- Security sign-off and KMS integration timeline.
- Clear cost forecasting for large-scale embedding refreshes (want to compare with self-hosting).
- On-prem installer / packaging ETA for air-gapped customers.

Other notes:
- Interested in Optimize features: auto-batching suggestions and model selection recommendations.
- Wants ability to route embed-only jobs to cheaper capacity tier and reserve low-latency nodes for streaming sessions.
- Mentioned Sourcegraph and Codeium as alternatives for copilot features; principal decision hinge is operational economics + security compliance.
